capabilities: convert a note to a folder note when an attachment is pasted or dropped
place pasted attachments inside the note's folder
require the default attachment location to be set to the current file's folder
disambiguation: Not a general attachment manager; it only triggers when you paste or drag-and-drop a file onto a note.
extras: README lists many other plugins by the same author (e.g. hide-index-files, virtual-dirs, folders-graph) but does not describe dependencies between them; notes that the 'Default location for new attachments' setting must be set to 'Same folder as current file' for it to work.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted or dropped attachments in a default location, so they don't end up grouped with the note they belong to unless the note is a folder note.
summary: Converts a note into a folder note when you paste or drag an attachment, so the file is stored inside the note's own folder.
